items.title: Lamar Jackson: On field to begin Week 8 prep
items.description:

items.title: Rashee Rice: Returning to practice Wednesday
items.description:

items.title: Stefon Diggs: Sitting out, but will be full go Thursday
items.description:
Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Diggs won't practice Wednesday due to an unspecified issue but is expected to be a full participant Thursday, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Sitting out practice due to shoulder issue
items.description:
Titans head coach Robert Saleh said that Tate won't practice Wednesday due to a shoulder injury, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
